description: Expected result shape for every provisioned dashboard panel when Prometheus is fed the synthetic series from infra/prometheus/synthetic-metrics.mjs (issue #160). 'series' means every target must return at least one time series. Add a panel here before adding it to awap.json; the live validation script fails on undeclared panels.

sentinel.description: Any target filtered by $tenant or $channel must return an empty result for a sentinel value that no series carries. This is the explicitly expected empty case.
